title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 80
paragraphs: So the Persians had established a siege. But Croesus, supposing that the siege would last a long time, proceeded to send from the fortress further messengers to his allies. For the earlier messengers had been sent round to give notice that they should assemble at Sardis by the fifth month, but these now he was sending out to ask them to come to his assistance as quickly as possible, since Croesus was now being besieged.
